Composite Bio-Age Model

The AFT Level 1 weighted algorithm across body composition from a Morpho scan, vital signs, and a biomechanical postural analysis. Thirteen markers, 100 weight points. Divergence capped at ±20 years.

PROVISIONAL RESULT. This is a Level 1 assessment. The fitness and blood and hormone domains are not measured at this tier, so the composite covers three domains rather than four. Adding a VO2max test and a blood panel completes the picture.
